exposure: Enhanced Recovery after Cesarean Surgery (ERACS) method
cohort: 140 mothers who underwent Cesarean sections (C-sections), divided into an ERACS intervention group and a conventional C-section control group.
finding: The ERACS method was effective in reducing pain levels 24 hours after C-section, and while there was no significant difference in satisfaction between groups, both ERACS and non-ERACS patients reported very high satisfaction based on the Customer Satisfaction Index.
